name: zeno-quickbooks-desktop
description: Controlled bookkeeping workflows for the local Zeno QuickBooks Desktop MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Workflow skills for Zeno, installed on Windows and working with QuickBooks Desktop. Set up company files, analyze books, prepare and review batches, and preserve a complete work record without sending the company file to the cloud.
defaultPrompt: Set up Zeno with my QuickBooks company files.
Show me the bookkeeping batches waiting for review.
Answer a question from my QuickBooks books.
